props.covers: The single preparation-to-publication process for source intake, external knowledge intake, reconciliation, recovery, and handoff.

text.insert: Sync reconciles observed upstream changes in isolated staging and publishes only after validation and operator confirmation. V2 intake runs against the canonical publication checkout before the durable boundary transaction completes.

steps.text: Observe and Acquire
Fetch the configured remote and record prior and observed upstream revisions, merged PR IDs, and requested corpus IDs. Equal upstream revisions make the request knowledge-only.
Record the request and refresh the Discord mirror on a best-effort basis. Failed refreshes preserve the archive already on disk.
Acquire the game dispatch lease. A running workflow settles its claims before handing over. Revalidate the lease during protected work.
Stage and Reconcile
A source-changing sync creates an isolated worktree at the cycle head. A knowledge-only sync skips source reconciliation.
Merge upstream into the staged cycle branch using the per-function score policy by default. The theirs policy is the explicit escape hatch.
Reconcile surviving open PR series with the same policy. A planned series with no branch or PR is skipped.
Persist workspace_created, cycle_merged, pr_series_reconciled, and validated as durable stages. Unresolved conflicts block on conflict_needs_operator.
Validate and Confirm
Validate clean staging, recursive submodule state, and the report comparison. Record validation evidence before entering validated.
If upstream changes, extend the staged merge to the observed tip and revalidate.
Require explicit sync.publish confirmation and recheck upstream plus the unchanged prior canonical head. Persist recursive publication intent before entering publishing.
Publish the Boundary
Repoint the canonical cycle worktree for a source-changing sync and verify the full recursive target state.
Run V2 knowledge intake against that canonical checkout and its report. Reconcile subjects, mechanically re-anchor code citations, then import PRs, Discord, and worker attempts.
Record head lineage, source invalidations, PR-push intents, and the knowledge_intake result in the durable boundary transaction. A knowledge-only pass keeps its prior source head.
Finish pending PR pushes with force-with-lease. Finalize published state, remove the publication intent, and release dispatch authority.
Cancel or Recover
Before publication starts, cancellation discards staging and records unchanged canonical and recursive submodule heads. It cancels queued dispatch intent or releases the held lease.
Publishing cannot be cancelled. A committed boundary resumes pending pushes and finalization.
Recovery preserves or discards pre-publication staging. Conflicts use sync.resolve_conflict. A raw interrupted publication restores the recorded prior recursive state and blocks for recovery.
V2 intake uses durable dedupe and result evidence on retries. It does not use the retired sync-stage knowledge-job queue.

text.insert: Intake fetches merged PR evidence into the canonical past_prs archive and can rebuild oversized diffs from a local merge commit. Reconciliation runs before citation re-anchoring. PR, Discord, and attempt importers then enqueue librarian tasks against the reconciled subjects.

Knowledge-only publication runs intake without moving the cycle head, creating a remote application, invalidating source results, or pushing PR branches. Its durable result is publication.knowledge_intake, not a legacy monotonic knowledge_revision field.
owns the later consumption of index tasks and validated fact writes. Sync publication does not wait for every librarian task to finish.

A V2 intake failure can occur after canonical repoint and before the boundary transaction. The durable publication intent is therefore part of recovery. Do not infer an untouched checkout from a missing publication record.
